summary: The PR moves the builder-family source off the self-written Aayudha-Model trailer. build now records each checkpoint's model on the ledger (CheckpointRecord.Model). inspect lists the PR's commits and calls inspect.BuilderOf, which treats the family as known only when a delegation or checkpoint records cover every commit with one family that the trailer does not contradict. Otherwise every named family becomes a candidate, and reviewerModels picks reviewers outside all of them. The verdict's first note names the family and its source, and it marks the trailer self-reported and unverified and build records attributed, not verified. Tests cover the trailer/record contradiction, no record, the honest case, and BuilderOf edge cases. One minor issue: a failed ListCommits call is silently treated as 'no record', which makes the verdict's source note misleading. The failure is fail-safe and does not block the story.

findings.quote: if cs, err := github.All(ctx, func(ctx context.Context, o gh.ListOptions) ([]*gh.RepositoryCommit, *gh.Response, error) {
findings.title: ListCommits error is dropped, so the verdict misreports the builder-family source
findings.detail: If listing the PR's commits fails (rate limit, transient API error), commits stays nil. BuilderOf then counts no checkpoint coverage, finds no recorded family, and the verdict's first note says 'no build or delegation record on the ledger names a model family for the PR's commits', even when the ledger holds a full build record. The outcome is conservative (the family is unknown and the claim and lane become candidates), but the note the story relies on (naming where the family came from) is wrong, and the reviewer choice silently changes on a transient error.
findings.fix: Handle the error: either return Wrap(ExitExternal, err) so the gate retries, or pass the failure into BuilderOf/the note (for example, 'the PR's commits could not be listed: <err>') so the verdict states the real reason the family is unknown.

criteria.evidence: BuilderOf returns an unknown family when the trailer contradicts the record and adds both families as candidates. The note includes 'trailer claims … (self-reported, unverified)'. TestInspectBuilderFamily case 1 (record openai, trailer claude-opus-5-5) is reviewed by grok-4.7 and the verdict contains 'none of [openai anthropic]'; evidence/criterion-1.jsonl.

With no trailer and no record, the note reads 'no build or delegation record on the ledger names a model family' plus the build lane's family on the pack's host. TestInspectBuilderFamily case 2 asserts both strings in the verdict; evidence/criterion-2.jsonl.

When the record and trailer agree, BuilderOf returns the known family with source 'the build record … attributed, not verified', and the reviewer (gpt-6.1-sol) is chosen as before. TestInspectBuilderFamily case 3 and the Model assertion in TestBuildTextDryRunPlanAndBudget cover this; evidence/criterion-3.jsonl.
